scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The exact classification determines use versus exclusion of one chord only; positive optimal weight values and multiple chords are not solved. The proof is analytic; finite rational computations check instances but not all parameters. Published work provides general convexity and fixed-base chord-update formulas; a historical equivalent specialized statement cannot be ruled out. The February 1, 2008 date is the verified electronic publication day of the primary methodological source; an earlier conference version is known from July 2006 without a verified first-public day.
title: Sharp price-distance threshold for a reweighted cycle with one optional chord
